name: Eris White
seed: To be recognized for what she built afterward rather than the accident.
design: White/sandy gorilla, tan face, blue-gray eyes, slate work wrap and copper measuring chain; no armor.
history: Gorilla’s older sister and a skilled terrace builder. Injured at twenty-five in the platform failure, recovered and adapted her work. Stayed in Stonewake and became a respected crew lead.
desire: To be recognized for what she built afterward rather than the accident.
contradiction: Turns independence into a refusal to admit when a task is difficult.
relationships: Loves Gorilla but rejects his guilt rituals; argues with Oren; guides Namu’s visiting crews through surface works.
arc: Asks her brother for specific help without letting him take charge of her life. Both learn mutuality.
story_engine: A sibling building contest; a letter congratulates her brother for work she actually led.
writer_truth: She never needed him to be invulnerable. She wanted him to listen when she said the platform should be emptied.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
